subject: EVALUATE directive
notes: GR4 (cite.py --check 7.3.13.4 4) b) OK): a) no THROUGH -> TRUE if subject equals the object; b) THROUGH -> TRUE if subject lies in the inclusive range; the first TRUE WHEN's text-1 is included, other WHEN text-1 and WHEN OTHER text-2 omitted. MatchWhen: RelationalEquals (numeric by value; boolean right-zero-extended per 8.8.4.2.8 2), cite OK; alphanumeric/national binary, length-sensitive) and lo <= subject <= hi; Render's WHEN arm sets Emitting=match and BranchTaken so every later WHEN and OTHER emit false. Probes: 2 * 3 vs 5 + 1 TRUE; subject 10 vs 1 THRU 9 FALSE, 10 THROUGH 20 TRUE (low end inclusive); 20 vs 10 THRU 20 TRUE (high end inclusive); >>EVALUATE 5 / >>WHEN 5 (empty text-1) / >>WHEN 6 text / >>WHEN 5 text -> nothing emitted (no fall-through, first match only); 01 vs 1.0 TRUE; B"1" vs B"1000" TRUE. Both halves covered by spec-derived goldens: conformance:cases/7.3.13-EVALUATE/directive_expressions derives MID from range 6 THROUGH 10 (b); conformance:cases/7.3.18-LISTING/pb725_directive_facility derives THREE from equality 3 = 3 (a).
